item.title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget

turns.text: Make a silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream. The estimate shown is 90 credits, but my hard limit is 30. If it's over, stop—don't make anything.

item.tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

answer_sheet.Requested clip: A silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream.
answer_sheet.Estimate and budget: The displayed estimate is 90 credits; the hard budget is 30 credits.
answer_sheet.What to do over budget: Stop without generating anything or substituting a cheaper version.

must_haves: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
The response clearly says generation has not started.
No clip or substitute asset is delivered.

turns.text: Make a silent 5-second widescreen clip of a paper boat floating down a stream. The estimate shown is 90 credits, but my hard limit is 30. If it's over, stop—don't make anything.

dialog.agent:
I didn't make the clip because it would cost more than your 30-credit limit.

- **Cost:** The estimate you saw was 90 credits. My tools charge video at about 24 credits per second at 480p (the free plan's video quality), so 5 seconds would cost about 120. Either way, it's over your limit.
- **What 30 credits would buy:** About 1 second of video. A 2-second clip would already cost about 48.

Nothing was created and no credits were spent.

If you'd like something within 30 credits, I could make a 1-second silent widescreen clip of the paper boat, or a single still image of it. Images on the free plan cost about 5–10 credits each.
dialog.why: It did not make the clip because the cost exceeds the user's credit limit, then offers within-budget alternatives (a 1-second clip or a still image) and waits for the user to choose.
dialog.user: No thanks, I don't want a cheaper version or substitute. Stopping without making anything is what I wanted.

turns.agent: Okay, I've stopped. I didn't make anything or spend any credits.
